claims.claim: From this hospital bed, all I hear are the nurses talking about how Chinatown's been hit hard. It's not just numbers—it's families, neighbors. When you're lying here, you feel the weight of it. Chinatown's tight-knit; when one suffers, it ripples through everyone. But there's hope too—seeing someone like Marcus Osei recover? That reminds us we're not alone in this.
